summary.text: Hu Immortal's palace on Dang Hun Mountain inside Hu Immortal blessed land, where Fang Yuan wakes after claiming the inheritance.

claims.text: Fang Yuan finds himself in a large bedroom: a huge round bed behind a thin pink silk curtain, golden brick walls, silver brick floors, and gems at the furniture and corners. Narration names the place Hu Immortal’s Dang Hun Palace. The land spirit reports he slept seven days with no attack on the blessed land, and that the women’s dresses stored there are not his size. After changing from clothing in tusita flower, he follows the land spirit up the stairs of Dang Hun Mountain.

Deviation (recorded): this page uses the Central Continent region field because Hu Immortal Blessed Land is a Central Continent blessed land. The palace itself sits inside that small world on Dang Hun Mountain, not as a main-world map seat.

A large bedroom holds a huge round bed that could fit forty to fifty people, behind a thin light pink silk curtain that sways with light wind and chimes. A silk blanket red on the bottom with golden rims covers the bed. A stove beside the bed burns incense. Golden brick walls and silver brick floors frame the room. Beside the bed, at the corners, and on tables, chairs, and a dressing table sit large amounts of pearls, agate, diamonds, and other precious gems. The room is grand, elegant, luxurious, and glorious.

The land spirit brings Fang Yuan to the palace in Dang Hun Mountain. In its deepest parts an enormous golden bowl holds green immortal essence that has mostly congealed into green grape immortal essence. Each pearl holds much more immortal essence than the store in Three Kings Blessed Land.

Fang Yuan counts seventy-eight pieces of green grape immortal essence plus a half from the liquid layer, a hundred times the three kings store. After feeding fixed immortal travel Gu, he leaves it to roam Dang Hun palace so long as it does not leave Dang Hun Mountain and meet the lightning shadow.
When rockmen present ores, gems, and Gu as offerings, Fang Yuan understands at once why Dang Hun palace was built so luxuriously.
